thought.text:
Pertanyaan bagus. Jawabannya bukan di API-nya, tapi di **protokol yang dipakai OpenHands**.

Saya cek dulu setup yang ada.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && ls -la ~/.openhands 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== config ==="; find / -name "settings.json" -path "*openhands*" 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "=== env ==="; env | grep -iE "llm|openhands|model" | sed 's/=.*/=<hidden>/' | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && ls -la ~/.openhands 2>/dev/null | head; echo \"=== config ===\"; find / -name \"settings.json\" -path \"*openhands*\" 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo \"=== env ===\"; env | grep -iE \"llm|openhands|model\" | sed 's/=.*/=<hidden>/' | head", "summary": "Inspect OpenHands LLM config", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}
